What chance do high-powered drift cars have going head-to-head against a BMW M2 in a drag race? 

Well, it’s time to find out! We’ve got Mat lining up in the standard BMW M2, and he’s going head-to-head against a Nissan 200SX and a Mercedes E-Class Limo, both of which have been tuned to specialise in drifting! This means they’re packing a whole load of performance, but will they be able to put it down over a straight line? Let’s take a closer look at the stats… 

Starting with the Nissan, it’s powered by a 6.3-litre Chevy V8 and a massive single turbo, and it puts down 804hp and 1,030Nm. This power is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed sequential gearbox, and all-in it’s valued at £130,000.

title: Turbo V8 LS-swap Nissan 200SX v BMW M2: DRAG RACE
